title: oscore response_window is dual-role across server/client contexts: false-replay DoS on bidirectional contexts
description: Found by 3x codereview of the rust-oscore observe port (9liz unblock work). Same root cause as project-LICHEN-worker6-ythw. In /home/mark/crates/oscore/src/lib.rs, response_seq/response_window is written by mark_response_used only from protect_response's no-PIV branch (server role: 'request PIVs whose nonce I reused for my own no-PIV responses') but is consulted by begin_unprotect_response_inner (~lib.rs:1308) as 'peer response PIVs I have accepted' (client role). A Context legitimately serves both roles; the two are independent sequence spaces, so on a bidirectional context a legitimate notification/response whose PIV numerically falls in the marked range of previously-answered request seqs is falsely rejected as Err(Replay) — a fail-closed DoS. Fix together with ythw by separating the windows or using the recipient window consistently on both paths. Machine-local clone; regenerate patches/rust-oscore-local.patch after the fix.
